top_categories.workout_context: 105ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
14,485ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Race-pace efforts that mimic L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
At mile 60 of 137, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.

Road-specific control matters at L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive. Practice on paved mountain roads through the Massif Central: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 137 miles.
14,485ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive. Train it until it feels boring.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 137 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Low-cadence force work supports 14,485ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 14,485ft of climbing on paved mountain roads through the Massif Central does to your power file on race day.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive’s 137 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at L'Ardéchoise Cyclosportive rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on paved mountain roads through the massif central to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and VO2max to prepare you for 137 miles of paved mountain roads through the massif central in Saint-Félicien, Ardèche, France.
